name: Kaine
source:
"We're friends, Noah. I'm not going anywhere."

Despite Noah withdrawing from both the world and him, Kaine's always stuck by his best friend through everything. His number one goal in life is to help Noah regain what he's lost.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound]Kickstarter[/url]]
